findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the interior baffles of the ice machine to be soiled with black biological growth. The person in charge (PIC) was informed. The PIC stated that the general manager is responsible for cleaning the machine. Ensure that the ice machine remains clean to sight and touch at all times to prevent contamination of ice. A follow-up will be conducted on September 21, 2026 to ensure the interior and exterior of the ice machine has been cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

Observed walk-in freezer to have rusty ice accumulating from the ceiling. There are tubs at the top of the shelf capturing the ice. The PIC stated that the trays must be emptied weekly to accommodate the flow of water. Ensure repairs are conducted to prevent rust contamination with food items stored in the freezer.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer bucket and triple sink in kitchen to measure 0ppm quaternary ammonia. PIC claimed that dispenser has been malfunctioning for some time. A different staff member was able to disassemble and replace to the nozzle of the dispenser. The sanitizer solution from the dispenser measured 100ppm quaternary ammonia after repair. The triple sink and sanitizer bucket was refilled with proper solution. This violation is considered corrected on site.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed three knives in the prep area metal rack to be soiled with food debris. The knives were removed from the rack and were placed in the ware-washing area to be cleaned and sanitized. Ensure staff are cleaning all equipment and utensils frequently enough to avoid accumulation of food debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed walk-in freezer to have rusty ice accumulating from the ceiling. There are tubs at the top of the shelf capturing the ice. The tubs were fairly full, suggesting the leak has been present for some time. Ensure repairs are conducted to prevent rust contamination with food items stored in the freezer.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Observed two jackets stored on dry storage shelves containing food. PIC was informed that employees need to use a designated area for personal item storage to prevent cross contamination. There seems to be a designated clothing rack in the office for personal items. Ensure staff are using this space rather than dry storage shelving for personal items.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(B) Designated Areas. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES can not occur.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed floors underneath dry storage shelves in back of facility to be soiled with food debris and refuse. Clean floors underneath shelving. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
